headline: Wipro Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is informed that…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is informed that merger of Wipro VLSI Design Services, LLC (step-down subsidiary) into Wipro IT Services, LLC (step-down subsidiary) is completed and is effective from October 1, 2026 (Eastern Time). The Company received intimation to this effect on October 3, 2026.

sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
